title: Normalized coefficient comparisons commute with the derived associators
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme, $\ell$ prime, and $S$ any System of [def-pur-finite-reduction-system]. For natural numbers $r\ge m\ge n$ and every $K\in D(T_{\mathrm{Et}},A_r)$, the comparison-associator square S.CoherentAt(r,m,n,K) commutes. This conclusion uses only the universal functors and the representative normalizations in System. In particular it assumes neither constructibility nor finite Tor amplitude of $K$ and includes exponent zero.

proof.text: Conjugate ordinaryComparison and the inverse ordinaryAssociator through their adjunctions. The conjugates are respectively the identity and the restriction-of-scalars composition comparison. Apply the proved CategoryTheory.conjugateEquiv_paste; the right-adjoint square is the identity on sections. Cancel the inverse associators to obtain the ordinary square.

proof.text: On a flat K-flat resolution Q, postcompose the desired square by the exact comparison factorization and the direct-extension counit. These are invertible. Naturality and the three normalization equations reduce the equality to the ordinary square degreewise.

Transport the equality from the resolution to K by naturality.
